label: sparse conjunction: d/b/k/p/2 after an s/z pair (weak)
explanation: Very sparse (0.015% of steps) and diffuse. Activations are mostly in the original phase (77% of mass) at t=3..10, and never at t<3 or in late copy steps (recall_idx>=3). It is enriched for inputs d/b/k/p/2 that come right after s/z (prev2_tok s gives 11x lift), in sequences that start with q/u/i/d/v/w and contain few digits. The strongest examples look like "q ? s s b". Some weaker activations also occur at <DEL> and at recall_idx 0-1. The tight conjunction predicate reaches only about 41% precision and 11% recall on dev, and broad versions (any s/z/k seen) have recall around 0.7 but precision below 1%. It looks like a conjunction of many distributed-state factors with no clean description. Magnitude is narrow (median 0.12, max 0.23), and I did not find anything that modulates it.
